spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the main Hawaiian Islands with extensive white cumulus and layered clouds over the northern islands and over the southwestern ocean, with clearer dark ocean in the central area west of Maui and west of Hawaii Island; the large southeastern island is partly cloudy with white clouds banked along its eastern and southern sides and otherwise brown-green land visible, no distinct gray or brown haze streak separable from meteorological cloud is visible.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: No overflows or spattering at north or south vents over the past day; strong glow and flames continue. No reactivation of Sept. 30–Oct.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
